name: services/groups/groups
description:
Get information on multiple groups.

This method is similar to the group method, but it works with multiple groups. It also has a limited fields support.

arguments.name: group_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of pairs identyfing groups (in the following format: "(course_unit_id,group_number)|...").

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of fields (as in the group method). Only primary fields are allowed.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your group_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain the description of a group, as defined in the group method.
